resources.string: Detects when you tap Copy in any app, so Edge Clipboard can save the text. It does not read the screen and sends no data.
Clipboard handle. Tap to open. Touch and hold to move.
No clips yet.\nText you copy shows here.
Tap the handle, or swipe it inward, to open your clipboard. Touch and hold the handle to move it. It snaps to the nearest edge. The app keeps your last 30 clips. Pinned clips stay.
Required. Shows the handle and the panel.
Recommended. Android blocks clipboard access in the background. This saves clips the moment you copy. Without it, clips save when you open the panel.
Shows the status notification that keeps the handle running.
Stops ColorOS from closing the handle.

1. Settings > Apps > Edge Clipboard > Battery usage: allow background activity and auto launch.\n2. In Recent apps, lock Edge Clipboard (pull the card down).\n3. If Copy detection turns off after a restart, turn it on again in Accessibility.
